question: What is the theme of this passage?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***A) The passage discusses the impact of overpopulation and land encroachment on forests and wildlife, particularly focusing on the endangered Black Buck.***

 
 
• The theme primarily revolves around the endangerment of species and conservation efforts, highlighting the Black Buck’s plight and protective measures.
 
 
 
• ***B) Overpopulation and land encroachment are mentioned as contributing factors but are not the central theme.***
 
 
• These elements support the main narrative but do not encompass the entire scope of the passage.
 
 
 
• ***C) The passage does not primarily focus on forests and their uses but rather on the consequences of human actions on wildlife.***
 
 
• The theme is centered on endangered species rather than general forest usage or benefits.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: Incorrect because overpopulation is mentioned as a cause but not the theme of the passage.
 
• **Option 3**: Incorrect because land encroachment is also a contributing factor but not the focus of the passage.
 
• **Option 4**: Incorrect because forests and their uses are not discussed in detail; the focus is on endangered species.
